Three headers exist, and they are mutually consistent in casing and form: '## BITCOIN:', '## ONCHAIN:', '## BALNA MOZGASOK:' - all ALL-CAPS, all colon-suffixed. FULL - matching both siblings, and the post's most consistently executed quality. Constructive framing without denial: 'Ez elsore bosszantonak tunhet, de...' names the disappointment before reframing it, and the reframe is a mechanism rather than reassurance. Opportunity framing is anchored to structure, not sentiment: 'a csatorna alj mostanra mar igy is feljebb kerult, mint a korabbi melypontok', and the CLARITY Act and Ripple pilot are presented as concrete positives. Risks are stated plainly and not minimized: 'erosebb eladoi nyomas jelent meg', 'A Bitcoin 80 ezer dollar ala esett, ami jelentos likvidalasokat okozott', 'az altcoinok is gyengultek', 'a nagyobb szereploknel nemi csokkenes jelent meg', 'a 200 napos mozgoatlagat nem tudta meg atlepni'. factual_check_ruling.verdict: NOT ADJUDICABLE FROM THIS CACHE - the claim is unverifiable, NOT demonstrably wrong, and I decline to manufacture a verdict either way. Three reasons, in order of weight. (1) TIMING: the cache holds only the 2026-05-17 as-of snapshot, not an intraweek series. The claim concerns the MOMENT of the rejection at the 200-day MA, and that moment was not 05-17 - the daily close of 78148.05 sits well BELOW the 81782.66 MA, while the weekly high of 82479.32 pierced it earlier in the week. The RSI reading at that earlier moment is not in the cache and cannot be reconstructed from it. A daily RSI travelling from roughly 70 mid-week to 48.89 by Sunday across a drawdown from 82479.32 to 77640.00 is arithmetically unremarkable, so the snapshot does not contradict the claim. (2) REFERENT AMBIGUITY: 'az RSI 70-es erteke' is standard Hungarian TA usage for the overbought REFERENCE LINE at 70, not necessarily for a measured reading of 70 - the 03-15 sibling used the identical construction ('a lendulet mar az RSI 70-el talalkozott'). Under that reading the sentence is a statement about a chart level, which a value cache cannot adjudicate at all. (3) The claim is untagged and chart-borne, so there is no stated timeframe, no stated timestamp and no restated magnitude to check against anything. SCORING CONSEQUENCE, applied without inventing a factual verdict: this is charged where the rubric actually locates the failure - A1 (untagged, already 0), A4 (no timestamp on the claim, contributing to the half) and B4 (the RSI magnitude is chart-borne and never restated for the relevant moment, contributing to the zero). It is NOT charged as a factual error, because the cache does not establish one. This is itself the cleanest illustration in the scoring of why A1 and A4 are not bureaucratic: an untagged, untimed, chart-borne number is not falsifiable, and unfalsifiable is a worse property than wrong.
